moments.text: Grey-scale camera looking down on broken white cloud with dark patches of ground and buildings. North marker at right; black boxes hide the overlay text.
A tiny bright spot enters at the right edge just above the lower-right black box and crosses diagonally to the left edge, over rooftops upper left. About 2 s.
The picture breaks into vertical stripes, then jumps to a closer view of rooftops and streets between the clouds.
The signal breaks up with vertical stripes at the edges; the view jumps several times between cloud and town.
The camera looks across the cloud tops at a shallow angle: rows of cloud, almost no ground, with stripe glitches coming and going.
After a brief breakup the view looks down again through broken cloud at roads and buildings until the clip ends.

notes: Review tool's old auto-crop 1070:900:422:180 (live has no crop; tool fixed) keeps a black band along the bottom (~180 px); picture ends near y=900.
